description: Find registered entities by name, UEI, CAGE, NAICS, PSC, state, set-aside or business type, status, or registrations expiring within N days. Costs credits like the REST call. Every answer has meta.as_of (the dataset date) and a record_url to the SAM.gov or USAspending source.

expiring_within_days.description: Registrations expiring within this many days.

set_aside.description: Business type or SBA program code, such as 8A.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: search_entities
